title: Term Life Insurance: End of the Waiver of Premium Rider at Its Expiry Age
content:
## Rule

The waiver of premium rider on a Term Life Insurance policy ends on the policy anniversary at which the insured's anniversary age reaches the product's waiver rider expiry age; Ashgrove then detaches the rider and sets the installment after the waiver rider ends by taking the waiver charge out of the installment premium on record.

The installment after the waiver rider ends is set only after the installment premium on record has been converted to quarterly direct billing for a policy whose returned bank drafts of the last 12 months have reached the returned-draft limit.

| Business effect | After the rider ends |
|---|---|
| Waiver of premium rider | no longer attached |
| Installment premium | the installment after the waiver rider ends |

## Invocation: `end_expired_waiver_rider_bcdc46e8`

**Capability.** Detaches the waiver of premium rider from one Ashgrove term policy and records its new installment: the rider is marked as no longer attached and the installment premium becomes the amount supplied.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `term_policy_id` — the reference number of the term policy whose waiver rider ends, read from the term policy lookup before the call; an identifier, as recorded.
- `new_modal_premium` — the installment premium to record once the rider is detached; USD, a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places (the tool rounds half to even to the cent if more decimals are given).

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("rider_detached" on success), `term_policy_id`, `waiver_of_premium_rider` (always False) and `modal_premium` (USD with 2 decimal places). Afterwards the policy record shows the rider detached and the new installment premium.
